basic_details.job_title: ISI Research Associate Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Statistical Institute (ISI) has announced 1 vacancy for the Research Associate post on a contractual basis for an initial tenure of one year, extendable up to a maximum of two years based on performance and funds. Candidates applying for the Kolkata-based position must hold a Ph.D. degree in Statistics or Mathematics with at least one publication in a Science Citation Index (SCI) Journal. The consolidated emoluments are 58000/61000/67000 + HRA category I/II/III as per DST OM depending on qualification and experience. Eligible applicants can apply via email with the subject Application f

how_to_apply: Prepare a cover letter addressed to the Professor-in-Charge, Theoretical Statistics and Mathematics Division.
Include a current resume in English with a recent photograph.

Provide the following details: (a) Name in block letters, (b) Permanent/Present Address, (c) Email address, (d) Telephone/Mobile No., (e) Parent's Name/Spouse's Name, (f) Date of birth, (g) Academic Qualifications with percentage of marks obtained in each examination starting from 10th class, (h) Experience if any, (i) Date of submission of Ph.D. thesis/Date of receipt of the Ph.D. degree, (j) List of post-doctoral positions if any, (k) List of publications and preprints, (l) A research statement including a summary of work done, (m) Copies of papers/preprints, along with at least two recommendation letters including one from the thesis supervisor, (n) Aadhaar Card/Voter Card/PAN Card, and (o) SC/ST/OBC/Differently abled status along with all documents/certificates/testimonials.
Ensure recommenders mail the letters directly to the address mentioned in the subject header with the subject header "Reference letter for ".
Send the complete application by email to [email protected] with the subject header "Application for RA" on or before 27 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: ISI Research Associate at a Glance

rows.details: Theoretical Statistics and Mathematics Unit, Kolkata
One year initially, extendable up to a maximum of two years
Consolidated emoluments of ₹58000, ₹61000, or ₹67000 per month plus HRA
35 years as on 27 October 2026 (relaxable for SC/ST/OBC/Women and differently abled candidates)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. degree in Statistics or Mathematics with at least one publication in a Science Citation Index (SCI) Journal. Researchers who have recently obtained their Ph.D. degree are also encouraged to apply.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Consolidated monthly emoluments are ₹58000 (Rupees Fifty-Eight Thousand only), ₹61000 (Rupees Sixty-One Thousand only), or ₹67000 (Rupees Sixty-Seven Thousand only) plus HRA as per rules of the institute, depending on qualification and experience in the three categories respectively. House Rent Allowance is payable with the respective emoluments as per the rules of the Institute. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ISI Research Associate
content_sections.text: Prepare a cover letter addressed to the Professor-in-Charge, Theoretical Statistics and Mathematics Division. Include a current resume in English with a recent photograph. Provide the following details: (a) Name in block letters, (b) Permanent/Present Address, (c) Email address, (d) Telephone/Mobile No., (e) Parent's Name/Spouse's Name, (f) Date of birth, (g) Academic Qualifications with percentage of marks obtained in each examination starting from 10th class, (h) Experience if any, (i) Date of submission of Ph.D. thesis/Date of receipt of the Ph.D. degree, (j) List of post-doctoral positions if any, (k) List of publications and preprints, (l) A research statement including a summary of work done, (m) Copies of papers/preprints, along with at least two recommendation letters including one from the thesis supervisor, (n) Aadhaar Card/Voter Card/PAN Card, and (o) SC/ST/OBC/Differently abled status along with all documents/certificates/testimonials. Ensure recommenders mail the letters directly to the address mentioned in the subject header with the subject header "Reference letter for ". Send the complete application by email to [email protected] with the subject header "Application for RA" on or before 27 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Short-listed candidates will be asked to give a seminar followed by an interaction with the faculty.

faq.question: Q1. Is the Research Associate position permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The appointment is purely on a temporary basis for an initial tenure of one year, extendable up to a maximum of two years.

faq.question: Q2. Are HRA or allowances paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes, House Rent Allowance is payable with the respective emoluments as per the rules of the Institute depending on the category.

faq.question: Q3. Who gets an age relaxation and how much?
faq.answer: Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC/Women and differently abled candidates as per rules, and age may also be relaxed for exceptionally bright candidates with relevant research experience.

faq.question: Q4. How are candidates shortlisted for selection?
faq.answer: Short-listed candidates are asked to give a seminar followed by an interaction with the faculty.

faq.question: Q5. What should be written in the email subject line when applying?
faq.answer: Applicants must send their application with the subject header "Application for RA".
